name: newfstatat
synopsis: int newfstatat(int dirfd, const char *restrict pathname, struct stat *restrict statbuf, int flags);
description: newfstatat is the underlying system call for fstatat, retrieving file status information for a path relative to a directory file descriptor. It allows for additional flags to modify behavior, such as following symbolic links.

parameters.name: dirfd
parameters.description: Directory file descriptor, or AT_FDCWD to use the current working directory

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the file or symbolic link

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a stat structure to store the file status

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior, such as AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
dirfd is not a valid file descriptor
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the appropriate types

bugs: Different fields in the stat structure may contain state information from different moments during execution, potentially leading to inconsistencies.
